text: Parfit's technical term for what actually matters in survival -- psychological connectedness and continuity, which can hold in degrees and can branch -- is '___.'
explanation: Because Relation R (unlike identity) can obtain to two successors at once and admits of degree, Parfit argues it, not numerical identity, is what grounds rational anticipation and self-concern -- a practically revisionary conclusion. Distinguish it from strict numerical identity, which is one-one and all-or-nothing.
